hero.title: Eurasia Foundation for Social Work
hero.subtitle: Empowering communities through professional social work practice
hero.description: Building bridges across cultures, fostering collaboration, and advancing social work education and practice in the Eurasian region.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be the leading platform for social work professionals across Eurasia, fostering collaboration, knowledge exchange, and professional excellence.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To strengthen social work practice, education, and research across the Eurasian region through international collaboration and professional development.

values.title: Our Values
values.excellenceDesc: Committed to the highest standards in social work practice and education
values.collaborationDesc: Building bridges between diverse communities and professional networks
values.innovationDesc: Embracing new approaches to address evolving social challenges
values.integrityDesc: Upholding ethical principles in all our work

newsroom.intro: News, announcements, and updates from the work of connecting social workers across Eurasia.

library.headline: Knowledge that
library.intro: A shared library for social workers, researchers, students, and institutions who want to learn from one another’s context.
library.emptyBody: Try another category or search term, or contact the EFSW academic team.
library.ctaBody: We welcome papers, case studies, and practice notes that help the region learn faster together.

research.label: Research
research.description: Academic writing, field studies, and cross-regional analysis from the EFSW network.

practice.label: Practice
practice.description: Practical resources designed to translate shared knowledge into real community contexts.

briefings.label: Briefings
briefings.description: Concise perspectives on policy and collaboration — ready for professional conversations.

article.newsCtaBody: The EFSW editorial team can help with context, interviews, and follow-up.
article.documentCtaBody: Our academic team can share the full paper and related material on request.

organization.headline: Four bodies.
organization.intro: EFSW is held together by four interconnected bodies — from strategic governance to active community practice across the region.
organization.ctaBody: Whether you're an individual practitioner, a student, or an institution — there's a place in this network for the work you do.

council.title: Executive Council
council.body: Sets strategic direction and keeps the work of the network anchored to its mission — ensuring every initiative serves the communities we exist for.

knowledge.title: Academic & Practice Network
knowledge.body: Connects academics, practitioners, and learners so knowledge moves in both directions — from theory into field, and from field back into learning.

partnerships.title: Regional Partnerships
partnerships.body: Works alongside universities, NGOs, government bodies, and partners across the region to build bridges and open new pathways for collaboration.

community.title: Member Community
community.body: Where members build collaborations, share opportunities, and scale their impact — the open space where the network actually lives.

professional.body: Practitioners and social work professionals contributing knowledge from the field.

student.body: Emerging social workers and academic learners shaping the next generation of practice.

institutional.body: Universities, NGOs, government bodies, and partner organisations working at scale.

organization.structureLede: An executive council sets direction; three bodies carry the work into knowledge, partnerships, and the member community.
